KVector.meaning: two original double scalars x/y; no label/font measurement
parseFacts: Strip source boundary delimiter chars then require exactly2 tokens split comma/semicolon/CR/LF. Both tokens original double parser. Empty input rejects.

Source object factory starts0 each side, not default property padding5/12/20. Trim source boundary chars, split comma/semicolon, requirekey=value pairs; unknownkeys ignored, repeated knownkey lastwins. Blank content keeps0.

ElkMargin.meaning: Spacing-derived top/right/bottom/left; same actual Spacing.parse as padding
parseFacts: Same shared Spacing parsing; actual zero default surrounding margin is distinct from nodeLabels.padding5.

IndividualSpacings.meaning: typed property holder parsed via actual option IDs and parseValue
parseFacts: Generic option string uses literal regex ;,; delimiter, then colon split and suffix metadata resolution; malformed IDs/values throw. This differs from dedicated top-level individualSpacings JSON-object field that iterates keys with $setOption.

Source local layoutOptions/properties scalar import only serializes string/number/bool via stringVal; complex local JSON values are not implicitly passed through as typed objects. Original native validation policies may reject clearly rather than silently ignore.

Global optsToCfg JSON-stringifies non-scalars before actual parseValue; this is not permission to invent arbitrary dict mappings. A serialized array works for KVector; colon-style JSONobject is not automatically key=value Spacing syntax.

parseValue returnsnull for absent/null literal, or empty string except ENUMSET. Invalidparse returnsnull and original setOption leaves property unchanged. Native strict errors/finite/alias policies remain separate explicit host adaptations.

ENUM is exact symbolic name then signed32 integer ordinal; no general case-folding. ENUMSET splits square brackets, whitespace and comma, ignores emptytokens, accepts per-member symbolic/ordinal, deduplicates by declaration ordinal. Empty string yields emptyset, literal null yieldsnull.
BOOLEAN onlytrue/false case-insensitive. DOUBLE original regex accepts NaN/Infinity/suffix dDfF; no float32 rounding. This observation does not remove native finite-value restrictions.
Core portAlignment.default DISTRIBUTED; Layered effective default JUSTIFIED. A standalone Core NodeContext fallback is not proof that an actual Layered pipeline omits algorithm defaults.
Core padding is12 (actual source), Layered padding12, MrTree20 and other provider defaults are independent. Padding is outside these20 and included only to prevent universal-default inference.

Core targets are original metadata targets; local original option import does not itself enforce those targets. Native global-target application/host errors remain explicit and require caller support.
